FROM RESEARCH TO THE FIELD

Advice with a feedback loop.

The research behind the experience, and what this demo covers.

Inspired by Agri-SAGE

Agri-SAGE combines retrieval, multi-agent reasoning and APSIM crop simulation. Its study compares Plan-and-Solve, Tree of Thoughts and Reflexion for maize in Mandya using 2015–2024 weather.

Read the original paper ↗

The community use case

A local farm advisor can explore scenarios, discuss trade-offs with a farmer, and prepare a clear draft for agronomic review.

What works in this prototype

Field inputs, scenario comparison, plan selection, advisory preview, device-local saving and text download.

What needs a backend

Live weather, retrieval from approved agronomy sources, LLM plan generation, APSIM execution, calibrated uncertainty, and shared records. All displayed yields and curves are illustrative demo values, not predictions or reproduced study results.

Before field use

Connect and validate the simulation pipeline with local agronomists. The paper identifies field validation as future work. This demo’s plans require expert review and are not instructions for farm operations.

Independent hackathon prototype. No affiliation with the paper’s authors.
